record.original_question: Characterise the Hankel operators on the Hardy space H 2 on the circle that are of trace class. (F. Holland)

evidence.quote: Characterise the Hankel operators on the Hardy space H 2 on the circle that are of trace class. (F. Holland)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{T}$ denote the unit circle and $L^2(\mathbb{T})$ the Hilbert space of square-integrable functions on $\mathbb{T}$ with respect to normalized Lebesgue measure. Let $H^2 = H^2(\mathbb{T})$ be the Hardy space, identified with the closed subspace of $L^2(\mathbb{T})$ spanned by $\{e^{ink}: n \geq 0\}$, and let $P_+ : L^2(\mathbb{T}) \to H^2$ be the orthogonal (Riesz) projection. For a symbol $\varphi \in L^\infty(\mathbb{T})$ (or more generally a suitable distribution on $\mathbb{T}$), the Hankel operator $H_\varphi : H^2 \to (H^2)^\perp$ is defined by
$$H_\varphi f = (I - P_+)(\varphi f), \qquad f \in H^2.$$
Recall that a bounded linear operator $T$ on a separable Hilbert space is said to belong to the trace class $S_1$ if $\sum_n s_n(T) < \infty$, where $\{s_n(T)\}$ are the singular values of $T$.

Problem: Give an intrinsic characterisation of those symbols $\varphi$ for which the Hankel operator $H_\varphi$ on $H^2$ is of trace class.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem was solved by V. V. Peller (1980), who showed that a Hankel operator $H_\varphi$ on $H^2$ belongs to the Schatten–von Neumann class $S_p$ ($0 < p < \infty$) if and only if its symbol (modulo analytic part) lies in the Besov space $B^{1/p}_{p,p}$. In particular, $H_\varphi$ is of trace class ($p=1$) iff the symbol belongs to the Besov class $B^1_{1,1}$. This is now a foundational theorem in the theory of Hankel operators.

status_evidence.title: An Excursion into the Theory of Hankel Operators (Peller)
status_evidence.snippet: Peller's theorem characterizes Hankel operators in Schatten–von Neumann classes S_p in terms of Besov spaces B^{1/p}_p, in particular the trace class corresponds to B^1_1.
status_evidence.claim: Trace class Hankel operators on H^2 are characterized by symbols in the Besov space B^1_1 (Peller, 1980).

status_evidence.title: Besov spaces in operator theory (Peller)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey describing how Besov classes characterize Hankel operators of Schatten-von Neumann class, with the trace-class case corresponding to B^1_1.
status_evidence.claim: The characterisation of trace class Hankel operators via Besov spaces is well established.
